blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Former President Rodrigo Duterte’s “cognitive impairment” has left him barely able to clarify matters that could help defend himself against the charges he faces before the International Criminal Court (ICC), his camp said. The claim was made in a 77-page pretrial filing dated Nov. 25 (Nov. 26, Manila time), months after the court ruled that the 81-year-old Duterte was fit to stand trial on three counts of alleged crimes against humanity stemming from incidents during his terms as mayor and president.
